$comment: The synthetic test catalogue (spec §10). scripts/db/gen-tests.ts turns it into migration 0015 and docs/TESTS.md. Schedules live in config/settings.json tests.schedules. needs: Setup items that must all be validated before the test runs. The journeys are in web/lib/tests/journeys; a unit test keeps their step keys equal to these.

tests.title: Witty answers a WhatsApp message
tests.description: A scripted message from the real test number reaches Witty through WhatsApp and Chatwoot, and Witty answers it.

steps.title: Send a scripted message from the test number
A w2_inbox row appears
Witty replies (counselor, rewrite or fixed)
The reply has no verify_errors
Chatwoot shows the outgoing message

tests.safety: Sends only from the test number in settings.test_identities, which must be in w2_trusted with is_test; the runner refuses otherwise.
tests.purge: w2_test_reset(test number) removes the conversation, messages and inbox rows.

tests.title: Witty qualifies a test student to HOT and creates the lead
tests.description: Witty's own test harness plays the scenario "qualify to HOT" on a reserved harness phone; the outbox delivers the lead to lead_intake, which creates a student_leads row marked is_test.

steps.title: Run the harness scenario "qualify to HOT" on a reserved phone
The conversation is classified HOT
The w2_outbox row is sent
A student_leads row with lead_source, lead_status and is_test

tests.safety: Uses a phone from the harness range (settings.test_identities.phone_prefix) that w2_is_test() confirms; nothing is sent to WhatsApp.
tests.purge: w2_test_reset(phone) for Witty's rows; the lead through b2b.leads_soft_delete with reason test.

tests.title: A website enquiry is verified by email and becomes a lead
tests.seam: website form → email code → verification → lead_intake
tests.description: The enquiry form on the preview deployment, with the test mailbox, sends a code; the test reads it from the mailbox and verifies it; the website hands the lead to lead_intake.

steps.title: Post the enquiry on the preview URL with the test mailbox
web_gate_attempts.code_sent_at is set
The code arrives in the test mailbox
Verify the code
verified_at and lead_id are set
The lead has lead_source website_form and is_test

tests.safety: Only the preview URL (never eduwit.in) and only the test mailbox; the attempt must be is_test before the code is verified.
tests.purge: The lead through b2b.leads_soft_delete with reason test; the website's is_test attempts go with its own retention.

tests.title: A catalogue change reaches website search
tests.description: A change to a designated test programme is picked up by the website's catalogue poll and shows in web_search with the current fee.

steps.title: Touch the designated test programme
web_catalog_state.refreshed_at advances
The programme is found by web_search with its current fee

tests.safety: Would write to the shared catalogue, which Eduwit One never alters (spec §2); off until the catalogue has its own test-programme function (a builder proposal).

tests.title: The web advisor answers a test student
tests.description: A session for the test student on the preview deployment gets one answer within 8 s, and its cost is recorded.

steps.title: Open an advisor session for the test student
One message is answered within 8 s
turns = 1 and cost_usd is recorded

tests.safety: Only on the preview URL, with a session opened as is_test.
tests.purge: The website's is_test advisor sessions go with its own retention.

tests.title: A lead posted to the B2B API is routed
tests.description: A test lead posted through the B2B intake API with is_test is created and gets a routing decision.

steps.title: Post a test lead through the intake API
The student_leads row exists, is_test
A b2b.engine_decisions row exists
Routed to the test partner or in-house

tests.safety: The lead's phone is in the test range (b2b.is_test_phone) and the request is marked is_test; a decision for any partner other than the test partner fails the run.

tests.title: A lead is pushed to the test partner and its event comes back
tests.seam: allocation → partner sandbox → partner event back
tests.description: A test lead allocated to the test partner is pushed to its sandbox endpoint; a signed contact_attempted event for it is applied.

steps.title: Post a test lead through the intake API
Pushed to the test partner's sandbox (2xx)
Post a signed contact_attempted event for it
partner_activities row and first_contact_at set

tests.safety: Only to the test partner in settings.test_identities, whose push goes to its sandbox endpoint; a push to any other URL fails the run.

tests.title: A lead falls to Spark and Spark's work comes back to B2B
tests.description: The test partner marks a test lead duplicate twice so it falls to in-house; Spark holds it; a call logged by the Spark test user flows back to B2B.

steps.title: Post a test lead through the intake API
The test partner marks it duplicate twice
integration_outbox delivers it to Spark
b2c.lead_records holds it (held_by_b2c)
The Spark test user logs a call on it
b2c.outbox done and b2b.b2c_writes 2xx

tests.safety: Only the test lead, the test partner and the Spark test user (is_test_user).
tests.purge: Spark's b2c.lead_delete with reason test, then b2b.leads_soft_delete with reason test.

tests.title: A Spark journey sends only to the test number
tests.description: The test lead is run through a journey in Spark's test mode; it advances a step and queues a send only to the test number.

steps.title: Run the test journey for the test lead
journey_runs advances one step
A send_queue row for the test number
Nothing queued for any other number

tests.safety: The lead must be is_test and its phone the test number (b2c.is_test_phone); a queued send to any other address fails the run.

tests.title: A creator's link leads to an attributed lead
tests.description: The test creator's witty2-go link records a click and an access code; the qualify scenario on that code creates a lead with the referral code, which shows in the creator's outcomes.

steps.title: Open the test creator's witty2-go link
w2_clicks and w2_access_codes rows with the code
Run the qualify scenario on that code
student_leads.referral_code is set
b2b_referral_outcomes shows it

tests.safety: Only the test creator's code and a harness phone.
tests.purge: w2_test_reset(phone) and b2b.leads_soft_delete with reason test.

tests.title: An alert email goes out and is acknowledged
tests.description: A synthetic P2 incident gets a delivery to the test recipient; the email is sent and delivered; it is acknowledged and resolved.

steps.title: Open a synthetic P2 incident with a test delivery
The email is sent
The email is delivered
Acknowledge and resolve it

tests.safety: Sends only to the test mailbox, or to Resend's test address delivered@resend.dev while none is set (D-068); the synthetic incident is kept out of the digest and the brief.
tests.purge: Nothing in the apps; the synthetic incident stays in Eduwit One's history, marked synthetic.
